description: Compute real SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of any file with the Web Crypto API — and verify against an expected hash.

faqs.a: The file is read into memory and hashed with crypto.subtle.digest, the browser's native Web Crypto implementation — the same algorithms servers use.
MD5 and other legacy hashes are not exposed by the Web Crypto API, so only the SHA-2 family (plus SHA-1) is available natively.
Paste the expected hash and the tool compares it case-insensitively, ignoring spaces and colons, then shows MATCH or MISMATCH.
Yes — hashing happens entirely on your device; the file is never uploaded.

howto: Choose a file and a hash algorithm.
The real cryptographic hash is computed locally.
Paste an expected hash to verify integrity.
title: File Hash Checker
